title.text: Sports & Live without cards — three views of the same games

n1.text: Timeline: games are blocks on a time axis, one row per league. The red line is now. Live blocks carry the score; the focused block opens the panel below. Left/Right moves through time, Up/Down through leagues.

n2.text: Scoreboard: big-type rows grouped Live / Starting soon / Final, like a stadium board. Finals show their score (Scores = Show, the default); under Hide until focused they read "Score hidden" until focused for 1 s. The right side is the focused game: muted live preview, linescore, actions.

n3.text: Guide: channels as a classic TV guide — Now and Next per channel, with the live game pulled out of the channel's schedule when a score feed matches it.

n4.text: Results: date rail (US Eastern days), My sports chips with league chips under the chosen sport (NBA vs College), rows grouped by league with your teams first. A Replay tag shows which games can be watched; team sports, tennis and F1 each get their own row shape. The right panel is the focused result: Watch replay, Game stats, Follow.

n5.text: Game page: opened from a result. Header with both teams and the final, tabs Game / Box Score / Standings, linescore, team stat bars and top performers. Watch replay and Follow sit in the header. Scores stay hidden behind Reveal when spoilers are on.
